map.由连杆质量、长度与角度求重力扭矩 使用指南: Gravity Torque from Link Mass, Length and Angle User Guide
map.输入连杆质量 m、臂长 L、姿态角 θ 与重力加速度 g，工具按 τ=m·g·L: Enter link mass m, arm length L, attitude angle theta and gravitational acceleration g, and the tool computes the gravity torque the joint must compensate as tau = m*g*L*cos(theta), for robotic arm gravity compensation and torque feedforward control.
map.输入质量 m、臂长 L、角度 θ、g，求关节重力扭矩。: Enter mass m, arm length L, angle theta and g to find the joint gravity torque.
map.水平臂重力平衡。: Gravity balance of a horizontal arm.
map.：τ=m·g·L·cosθ=5×9.81×0.3×1=14.7 N·m（θ=0: : tau = m*g*L*cos(theta) = 5 x 9.81 x 0.3 x 1 = 14.7 N*m (theta = 0, horizontal, maximum).
map.：cos90=0 → 重力矩为 0，无需补偿。: : cos 90 = 0, so the gravity moment is 0 and no compensation is needed.
map.由 (x,y) 反解关节角 θ₁,θ₂: Solve joint angles theta1, theta2 from (x,y)
map.由末端线速度与臂长求关节角速度: Joint angular velocity from end linear speed and arm length
map.臂与水平夹角；水平 θ=0 时重力矩最大。: Angle between the arm and the horizontal; at horizontal theta = 0 the gravity moment is largest.
map.各连杆重力矩求和，质心法向距离累加。: Sum the gravity moments of each link and accumulate the normal distance of the centre of mass.
